title: Practice 19: Short adjectives: занят, готов, рад

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: This style of cooking is peculiar to China.
exercises.why: Этот автомобиль новый.* There is, however, a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively: *Это больной человек.* but *Этот человек болен.* The past and future are formed by the use of the verb "**быть**": *Вчера я был занят. Завтра я буду свободен.* The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier. готовый — ready — готов, готова, готово, готовы. свободный — free — свободен, свободна, свободно, свободны.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 57.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
